style.summary: Duolingo sets dark grey #4B4B4B text on white screens, where answer cards, word chips and number tiles stand on a 4 to 6 pt bottom edge, like keys. Owl green #57CC02 fills progress bars and correct answers, streak orange #FF9600 marks the streak, and each subject owns a caption color. Cartoon characters appear on 5 of 8 shots, and every store caption sits in a lowercase colored bar.

screenshots.alt: Learn 40+ languages for free: the course list, from Spanish and French to Chess, Math, Music, Chinese and Korean
Fun, bite-sized lessons: pick the image for 牛乳 from tea, milk, cheese and juice, with 25 energy left
Solve chess puzzles: a coach says move here to checkmate, with an arrow on the board and 24 energy left
Build language skills: ¡Necesito más café! becomes I need more coffee! in word chips, with 23 energy left
Practice conversations: Eddy says Je voudrais un café, s’il te plaît ! in a café, next to a bear at the counter
Keep your daily streak: the owl flexes beside a flame over a 3 day streak, Sunday to Tuesday checked
Use math with confidence: build 36 from number tiles and × and + signs, with 22 energy left
Learn to play music: a piano lane marked Perfect! and a fill in the blanks quiz on a music staff

trial.evidence: If you like Duolingo, try Super Duolingo for 14 days free!

ourRead: Every course is free, and an energy meter sells Super. Lesson screens show it falling 25, 24, 23, 22; Super’s perks include Unlimited Energy.
Super starts with 14 days free. Monthly Streak Repair ties it to the streak counter, so a missed day becomes a reason to pay.
6 Super listings run from $9.99 to $119.99. Gems add a second ladder: 1,200 for $4.99 up to 6,500 for $19.99, which gives 35% more gems per dollar.

improvements.title: Name each Super listing by its length
improvements.detail: The App Store shows 6 items named Super Duolingo, from $9.99 to $119.99. Add the length to each name, like “Super Duolingo, 1 year”, so shoppers can compare prices before install.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Show energy in grey until it runs low
improvements.detail: Lesson screens put a pink energy meter next to the progress bar, so 2 colors compete above every question. Draw energy in grey #4B4B4B and turn it pink under 5, when Unlimited Energy starts to matter.
improvements.rule: One accent per screen. Directing attention means one place to look.

improvements.title: Darken the caption fills to pass 3:1
improvements.detail: 7 of 8 captions put white text on bright fills at 2.1 to 2.5:1. Fill each with the darker shade of its bottom edge, like #CE6603 under the orange, which reads at 3.8:1.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Duolingo's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% white #FFFFFF: every screen and card; text #4B4B4B; borders #E5E5E5.
- 30% owl green #57CC02: progress bars, correct answers and success states.
- 10% streak orange #FF9600: the streak count and done days.
- One bright color per section header bar.
Type:
- Headlines: Livvic 700, close to Feather Bold, lowercase, about 36 pt.
- Body: Barlow 700, close to DIN Next Rounded, 16 to 20 pt prompts; Barlow 500 for 20 pt chips.
Shapes:
- Cards, chips and buttons: 10 to 13 pt corners, 2 pt #E5E5E5 border, 4 to 6 pt darker bottom edge.
- Progress bars: 17 pt pills.
Layout:
- 16 pt side margins; one question per screen; answers in a 2-column grid or chip bank.
Components:
- Answer card: white, grey key edge; selected turns light blue with a blue border.
- Word chip: 45 pt tall, 16 pt side padding; correct: #D7FEB7 fill, #A6EC70 border.
- Streak week: 7 circles, 33.5 pt; done days orange with white checks.
Icons and imagery:
- Flat cartoon characters and flat object art; bold rounded icons.
Check:
- Every tappable card has a 4 to 6 pt bottom edge.
- Headlines are lowercase.
- Green marks only progress and correct answers.
